description: This file defines the OA_Dll_Tracker class, which manages tracker entities in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for creating, modifying, deleting, linking to campaigns, and retrieving tracker information, along with validation and permission checks.

classes.name: OA_Dll_Tracker
classes.description: A class for managing tracker entities, including creation, modification, deletion, linking to campaigns, and data validation within the Revive Adserver system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates tracker data, checking required fields and existence of trackerId when modifying.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Creates or updates a tracker, performing permission checks and data validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a tracker by ID after permission and existence checks.

methods.name: linkTrackerToCampaign
methods.description: Links a tracker to a campaign, ensuring both exist, permissions are valid, and they share the same advertiser.

methods.name: getTracker
methods.description: Retrieves tracker information and populates an OA_Dll_TrackerInfo object.

methods.name: checkSameAdvertiser
methods.description: Checks if a tracker and a campaign belong to the same advertiser.
